  • Method Details

    • summarizeSince

      @Query("SELECT new com.lemarketjames.activity.InstrumentActivity(\n f.instrumentId, COUNT(f), SUM(f.quantity), SUM(f.quantity * f.price), MAX(f.filledAt))\nFROM RecordedFill f\nWHERE f.filledAt >= :since\nGROUP BY f.instrumentId\nORDER BY f.instrumentId\n") List<InstrumentActivity> summarizeSince(@Param("since") Instant since)
      Sums the fills from a moment on, per stock. The database does the adding up, so the number of fills in the window never becomes rows in memory.
      Parameters:
      since - the start of the window, included
      Returns:
      one row per stock that traded, in instrument id order; a stock with no fill has none
